_: Annotated install-guide screenshots used by site/youtube.html (the install page). name.webp is light, name-dark.webp the dark variant (shown via prefers-color-scheme). Made with scripts/guide-shots.
ext-1-download: Extension 1: Click this button. A file called Tubeless.zip downloads.
ext-2-unzip: Extension 2: Open Downloads, double-click Tubeless.zip, move the Tubeless folder to Documents. (Mac Finder; light only; hidden on Windows/Linux)
ext-3-extensions-page: Extension 3: Copy chrome://extensions, open a new tab, paste into the address bar, Enter.
ext-4-developer-mode: Extension 4: Switch on Developer mode (top right).
ext-5b-pick-folder: Extension 5: Pick the Tubeless folder, click Select. (macOS folder picker; light only; hidden off Mac)
ext-6-open: Extension 6: Done. Click the Tubeless icon next to the address bar (puzzle piece if not pinned).
bm-desktop-drag: Bookmark (computer) 1-2: show the bookmarks bar, drag the Tubeless button onto it.
bm-desktop-click: Bookmark (computer) 4: on youtube.com, click Tubeless in the bookmarks bar.
ios-2a-menu: iPhone 2: tap the menu button left of the address.
ios-2c-title-save: iPhone 2: type Tubeless as the name, Save.
ios-3a-hold-favorite: iPhone 3: tap the address bar, touch and hold Tubeless under Favorites.
ios-3c-paste: iPhone 3: clear the address, touch and hold, Paste.
ios-4b-youtube-text: iPhone 4: the plain-text YouTube page that 'Open YouTube for Tubeless' opens.
ios-5-run: iPhone 5: tap the address bar, tap Tubeless under Favorites.
safari-4-youtube-text: Safari (Mac) 4: the plain-text YouTube page (light only).
